# Sanjana Enterprises

> Sanjana Enterprises is an ISO 9001:2015 certified waterproofing and industrial flooring company based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. With 30+ years of experience, we serve residential, commercial, and industrial clients across Bangalore and Karnataka.

Sanjana Enterprises (also known as Sanjana Waterproofing) specializes in terrace/roof waterproofing, basement waterproofing, water tank waterproofing, water leakage detection, epoxy flooring, PU flooring, ESD flooring, anti-corrosion coating, and structural repair services.

**Contact:** +91-9916290799 | sanjana.waterproofing@gmail.com  
**Website:** https://www.sanjanawaterproofing.com  
**Address:** #786/1/30&31, 3rd Main, 2nd Cross, Telecom Layout, Beside Muneshwara Temple, Srirampura, Jakkur Post, Bangalore 560064, Karnataka, India  
**Hours:** Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM  
**Service area:** Bangalore and all of Karnataka, India

- [Water Tank Waterproofing](https://www.sanjanawaterproofing.com/water-tanks-waterproofing): Overhead and underground tank waterproofing with potable-safe materials
